title: Friends Through the Roof
reflectionQuestion: Four friends would not give up until they got their friend to Jesus. Who is a good friend you are thankful for?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (extra, emotional room = FRIENDSHIP + determination). Adam's #1 missing story. The man who cannot walk is portrayed with dignity (matter-of-fact, the friends' love is the point, not pity). 'Your sins are forgiven' is kept simple, with the heart on the friends' faith + the healing + walking home. The roof-digging is the indelible/joyful image. longEligible=TRUE -- the long earns it (the crowd, the roof, the lowering, the healing). Will get short+full+long. 'God'/'Jesus' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_BARNABAS_ENCOURAGER (encourager -- friends lifting up a friend).
